description: This source file contains a utility class for JSON serialization and a set of custom JsonConverter implementations for serializing and deserializing various Orleans-specific types such as IPAddress, GrainId, ActivationId, SiloAddress, MembershipVersion, UniqueKey, IPEndPoint, and GrainReference. It supports configuring Newtonsoft.Json serializers to handle Orleans types efficiently.

classes.name: OrleansJsonSerializer
classes.description: Utility class for configuring Newtonsoft.Json JsonSerializerSettings to support Orleans types. Provides methods to serialize and deserialize objects with specified settings.

classes.name: IPAddressConverter
classes.description: Custom JsonConverter for serializing and deserializing System.Net.IPAddress objects as strings.

classes.name: GrainIdConverter
classes.description: Custom JsonConverter for serializing and deserializing GrainId objects as JSON objects with Type and Key properties.

classes.name: ActivationIdConverter
classes.description: Custom JsonConverter for serializing and deserializing ActivationId objects as parsable strings.

classes.name: SiloAddressJsonConverter
classes.description: Custom JsonConverter for SiloAddress objects, serializing to and from their parsable string representation.

classes.name: MembershipVersionJsonConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for MembershipVersion, serialization as a long value.

classes.name: UniqueKeyConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for UniqueKey objects, serializing as a hex string.

classes.name: IPEndPointConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for IPEndPoint objects, serializing Address and Port properties.

classes.name: GrainReferenceJsonConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for GrainReference objects, serializing reference details including GrainId and interface type.

methods.name: OrleansJsonSerializer
methods.description: Constructor initializing JsonSerializerSettings based on provided options.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserialize an object of expected type from JSON input string.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serialize an object to a JSON string.

methods.name: CanConvert
methods.description: Determine if the converter can handle a given type.

methods.name: WriteJson
methods.description: Serialize the object to JSON using a JsonWriter.

methods.name: ReadJson
methods.description: Deserialize JSON to object of target type.
